title: GOD MARS | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
GOD MARS (EP01 - 64)
A young boy is sent from a distant star to destroy Earth, but after experiencing the beauty of the planet and its inhabitants, begins to question his mission. With the aid of the powerful robot God Mars, the boy struggles to protect Earth from his own people, and as a result, is forced to do battle with his very own brother.


© Hikari Productions/TMS
#GODMARS #RokushinGattai #TMSanime

title: We Rent Tsukumogami | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
We Rent Tsukumogami  (EP01 - 12)
A pair of adopted siblings run a rental shop in old Edo (Present-day Tokyo) where fire and flooding is prevalent and everyday items are rented out to not impede when they flee. Mixed in the inventory are old objects that have turned into spirits after hundreds of years of existence called, Tsukumogami. These supernatural creatures listen to conversations around town and spread it as gossip. It is up to the good-hearted siblings to react to these quarrels and resolve the situation using the powers of the Tsukumogami.


©2018 Megumi Hatakenaka, KADOKAWA/Tsukumogami PARTNERS
#WeRentTsukumogami #TsukumogamiKashimasu #TMSanime

A hilarious and heartwarming classic! When Hiroshi accidentally trips over a rock and smack-dab onto a frog named Pyonkichi, the most incredible thing happens… the frog becomes a lively graphic on the front of his shirt! For a T-shirt frog, Pyonkichi sure has a lot of ridiculous advice!

title: Galaxy High School | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
Galaxy High (EP01 - 13)
Von Reichter is a professor who works on experiments in South America, creating the Cyber Series, artificial humanoids with super strength. One of the Cybers, Cybersix, escapes and arrives in the city of Meridiana. Disguising herself as school teacher Adrian Seidelman, after the real one was killed in a car accident. While saving the city from Reichter's creations, Cybersix defeats monsters called "Fixed Ideas"and drinks "sustenance", in order to survive. Along the way, she meets a boy, Julian, Reichter's son Jose, and high school teacher Lucas Amato.


© TMS
#GalaxyHighSchool #GalaxyHigh #TMSanime

title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 (1977)
description:
About LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 
Five years have passed since master thief Lupin and his gang made their daring escape out of Japan and went their separate ways. Then one day Lupin, Jigen, Goemon and Fujiko each receive an invitation from Lupin for a reunion aboard the luxury liner Sirloin. Reunited on the ship, they discover Lupin didn't send the invitations and the reunion is a trap by a vengeful Mister X, the Leader of the Scorpion Gang! Foiling Mister X’s plot while evading his ICPO nemesis, Inspector Zenigata, is all in a day’s work for Lupin and his gang, as their heisting adventures around the globe begin again!

For more information about other series: https://tmsanime.com/project/lupin-the-3rd-part2

title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 4 | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
LUPIN THE 3rd PART 4
A beloved classic franchise, LUPIN THE 3rd PART4 will be the first full-fledged Lupin the 3rd television series to air since 1984 when Lupin the 3rd Part 3 aired. The new story takes place in Italy and San Marino and features a blue-jacketed Lupin in his 20s. Lupin the 3rd follows the escapades and adventures of master thief Arsene Lupin III, a brilliant thief who has been able to carry off heists no one ever thought possible. Although he has been arrested and jailed on multiple occasions, he has always managed to escape.


Original comic books created by Monkey Punch
© Monkey Punch All rights reserved.
© TMS All rights reserved.
#LupinThe3rd #MonkeyPunch #TMSanime

description:
CAT'S EYE (EP01 - 73)
The three Kisugi sisters, Hitomi, Ruiand Ai, run a small cafe called "Cat's Eye.” To discover the whereabouts of their father, Michael Heintz, Hitomi, and her sisters rob art galleries as the thief "Cat's Eye" in the hope that his works can give them clues about his disappearance. However, Hitomi has a relationship with Toshio, a police inspector who has sworn to catch "Cat's Eye.” And of course, he has no idea about Hitomi's double life.


© Tsukasa Hojo / Coamix・TMS　1983
#CatsEye #TMSanime

Cobra, a famous space pirate with a psycho-gun hidden in his left arm, supposed dead for two years, is back in action. He falls for bounty huntress Jane Flower, whom crime lord Necron wants dead, and tries to help her save her world.


©BUICHI TERASAWA／ART TEKNIKA・TMS

title: ItaKiss | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
ItaKiss (EP01 - 25)
After an earthquake ruins her house, Kotoko Aihara stays at her father’s friend's house. The only problem is… his son is Naoki, the boy who rejected her love confession and embarrassed her in front of the class! This hilarious school comedy follows their will-they-won’t-they romance to its heart-pounding conclusion.


© Kaoru Tada / Project Itakiss
#ItaKiss #ItazuranaKiss #TMSanime

title: Actually, I am... | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
Actually, I am... (EP01 - 13)
Asahi Kuromine is a high school student who supposedly cannot keep a secret. One day he spots his crush Yoko Shiragami, unfurling a large pair of wings from her back. She explains to him that she is a vampire and is only able to attend a normal school on the condition that no one discover her true identity. Asahi swears to keep her secret but finds it hard to maintain seeing as how Yoko herself is an airhead and Asahi's friend Mikan keeps bullying the two of them.


© Eiji Masuda (Akitashoten)/Jitsuwata Film Partners
#VampireGirlfriend #MonsterSecret #TMSanime

title: BRAVE 10 | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
BRAVE 10 (EP01 - 12) 
Priestess Isanami’s shrine was destroyed by Ieyasu Tokugawa for siding with Yukimura Sanada, who’s been gathering the 10 brave warriors with the power to change history. But Isanami has a mysterious power of her own… This gripping historical action anime features samurai, ninjas and magic!

©Kairi Shimotsuki / MEDIA FACTORY・BRAVE 10 Project
#Brave10 #TMSanime

title: KenIchi - The Mightiest Disciple | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
KenIchi - The Mightiest Disciple (EP01 - 50)
Kenichi wants to be cool and strong but is always bullied for being a weak nerd. When a cute girl named Miu transfers to his school, she invites him to train at the mysterious dōjō where she lives. Soon, he'll be a martial arts master! Directed by Hajime Kamegaki (Naruto Shippūden the movie).


© Syun MatsuenaShogakukan / TV TokyoKenIchi Project
#KenIchi #MightiestDisciple #TMSanime

title: Virtua Fighter | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
Virtua Fighter (EP01 - 24)
The story begins with Akira Yuki as he begins his quest in search of his true inner strength and character, and the eight shining stars which are only visible to those who have mastered this strength from within. During the course of his journey, he meets Pai Chan who is fighting for her freedom and at the same time running away from her fiance as he wants to make the powers of the Lau Chan Group his own by marrying Pai. The always good-natured Akira ends up freeing Pai from her fiance. While on the run, the two meet Jacky and Sarah Bryant who both end up supporting Pais cause and the four decide to travel together.
Meanwhile, Kagemaru is approached by a secret clinic to kidnap Sarah to use her as a database for the creation of an android to be used as a war weapon. To collect this data, Sarah is brainwashed and turned into a fighting doll. Akira, Pai and Jacky venture out together to free Sarah from her kidnappers.
Can the Virtua Fighters stop the creation of the androids?


© SEGA / TMS
#VirtuaFighter #TMSanime

title: ZINBA | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
ZINBA (EP01 - 52)
Kan stumbles into a world where humans live with beings called ZINBA. Kan discovers his abilities as a Linker, and sets off on numerous adventures with his ZINBA, KING STAR, and their many friends.
ZINBA are creatures that have Force Stones as their energy source.  The stones can be seen on their bodies.  Force Stones are the energy source for everything in this world and Linkers are ones who can create force stones, connecting with ZINBA.  
Place a Force Stone on your ZINBA, and Battle!!


© ZINBA PROJECT
#Zinba #TMSanime

© Ikki Kajiwara・Jiro Tsunoda / KODANSHA・TMS

New Tetsujin 28 (EP01 - 51)
Shotaro Kaneda is a young boy whose dead scientist father created the giant robot Tetsujin 28 after realizing the chances of attacks from outer galaxies. Shotaro has possession of the only controller, kept in an attached case, which enables him to have direct command of the all-mighty Tetsujin 28. If the controller goes into the hands of the enemy, this could lead Tetsujin 28 to fight villains who want to destroy The Earth. Whenever peace in this world is threatened, Shotaro, together with his friends, Dr. Shikishima, and Detective Otsuka, must unleash the power of our metallic superhero.

title: GOD MAZINGER (Space Adventure ) | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
GOD MAZINGER (EP01 - 23)
In the ancient, legendary past, the peaceful kingdom of Mu is under siege by the war-like Dragonian Empire. With a woeful amount of fire power and only a giant statue of a deity to watch over them, the young Queen Aira and her people are no match for the Dorado, the Golden King,and his army of dinosaurs.
But Aira reaches out to someone who can save them, a warrior from another time and place. That person happens to be Yamato Hino, an average though highly athletic high school boy in modern-day Tokyo. At first Yamato think she’s going crazy when he gets messages from a spectral young woman, but she eventually convinces him to take the plunge… through a mystical portal to ancient Mu.
Before the Tokyo teen can get acclimated, Dragonia attacks again, but this time, the dinosaurs and soldiers are repulsed by the giant God Mazinger, now merged with Yamato. Though Mu has achieved it's first victory, they have along way to go, as does Yamato, who will need to over come his own deep character flaws and become a true warrior to save the kingdom and get back home.


© Dynamic Planning・TMS/1984
#GODMAZINGER #SpaceAdventure #TMSanime

title: Knight Hunters Eternity (Weiss Kreuz Gluhen) | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
Knight Hunters Eternity (EP01 - 13)
The battle between good and evil is never-ending, and the fate of the future is now laid upon the shoulders of four young lads, Aya, Yoji, Ken, Omi, and two new members, Sena and Kyou. They are the Knight Hunters who bring vicious criminals to justice.
Kouwa Academy under the guise of a high-quality educational institution for grooming elites, is educating a vast number of talented students. However, a dark power prevails on this campus as well. A series of unexplainable suicides occur, and the academy is suspected of involvement in the frequent outbreaks of terrorist activities throughout the world. Furthermore, an unspeakable project is underway in the confines of the academy.
The Knight Hunters are sent out on a mission to explore the activities of the academy. Aya sneaks into the academy as a teacher of world history, while Sena and Kyou disguise themselves as new students. Yoji and Ken fly to Europe to investigate the secret, terrorist activities that are being carried out behind the scenes at the Kouwa Academy in Europe.
The battle between good and evil has begun. As the Knights stand up against the mighty forces of the black power, each knight inevitably ends up fighting with the contradictions between what they believe in and reality. The battle is unimaginably tough since the Knights are not allowed to follow their hearts.


©Animate Film / MOVIC・Kids Station Inc. 2002 All Rights Reserved.
#KnightHunters #WeissKreuzGluhen#TMSanime

title: Go Nagai's "The Devil Lady" | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
Go Nagai's "The Devil Lady" (EP01 - 26)
Jun Fudo, a beautiful supermodel, finds a dark secret in her own genes. Upon meeting Asuka Ran, a mysterious woman seeking to eliminate all "beasts", the power within Jun awakens. With a capricious grip on her own humanity, and a beastly power boiling within her, Jun evolves into Devilman Lady.


© Go Nagai/Dynamic Planning-MBS-UNIVERSAL MUSIC-TMS All right Reserved 
#TheDevilLady #GoNagai #TMSanime

title: Requiem From The Darkness | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
Requiem From The Darkness (EP01 - 13)
The government of the Tokugawa shogunate is about to collapse, and the people of Edo (present-day Tokyo) live in a society stealthily eroded by the Darkness... Set in the late Edo Period (mid-19th century) in Japan, Momosuke meets a strange group of outlaws, Mataichi, Ogin, and Miminaga on one stormy night. He somehow knew they were from the other side. the Dark Side - of the world. But he never knew his experience with Mataichi Group and something he would witness would alter his humdrum life forever. Of course, Momosuke did not have a clue how he would be involved with these people and the otherworld where Mataichi and his Group came from...
Darkness is hidden inside human minds and the people who battle the wickedness inside human nature. With amazing skills of illusion and art, Mataichi Group sheds light on the darkness in human minds to liberate the spirit from evil.


© Natsuhiko Kyogoku / TMS
#RequiemFromTheDarkness #KousetsuHyakumonogatari #TMSanime

description:
YOWAMUSHI PEDAL (EP01 - 38)
Freshman otaku Sakamichi is heartbroken to find the anime club he wanted to join is no more. He never expected to join the cycling team instead. And he certainly never expected to discover he has a talent for racing! Maybe he can even convince his new friends to watch anime with him too...

#YowamushiPedal #SportsAnime #TMSanime

title: YOWAMUSHI PEDAL GRANDE ROAD | English Sub | Full Episodes
description:
YOWAMUSHI PEDAL GRANDE ROAD (EP01 - 24)
Sakamichi Onoda loves animation so much, that ever since he was in elementary school hes ridden his bike into the animation mecca, Akihabara, which is over 90 kilometers away.
The first thing he wanted to do after getting into Sohoku High School, was join the animation club.
However, his hopes of finding like-minded friends that shared his passion for anime were dashed when he discovered that the club had already been abolished.
He decides to gather other students together to try and re-form the animation club, and as he rides his bike up a hill singing to himself, another freshman named Imaizumi sees him, and challenges him to a race.
Afterwards, he bumps into Naruko in Akihabara, another fellow bicyclist.
They find themselves riding their bikes together, and Naruko is surprised at how great a bicyclist Sakamichi is.
Sakamichi starts riding his bike with everyone, and eventually comes around and decides to join the bicycling club. But within the club, the best team members are chosen to represent their school in the competition to see which high school has the best bicycling team.
Sakamichi has just joined the club, will he be chosen to represent his school?
The heated race begins!


© Wataru Watanabe (Akitashoten) 2008／Yowamushi Pedal GR Film Partners 2014
#YowamushiPedal #SportsAnime #TMSanime

title: The Journey Home - New Adventures of Space Bug | English Dub | Full Episodes
description:
The Journey Home - New Adventures of Space Bug 
This story is about Midge, a sleeping chironomid. Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. An epic space adventure of Midge and his friends of their journey back home to Earth.
Development plans and experiments are aborted by humans for no known reason, and organisms are left behind in the space station with limited resources. Going over hurdles and fighting through challenges, together, they travel across planets and gain new comrades, heading for Earth. As their journey progresses, the mystery behind the human’s abandonment unravels…


©W.BABA & TMS
#JourneyHome #SpaceBug #TMSanime
